items.excerpt: Apple's camera-equipped AirPods will put a camera in each bud, capturing synchronized low-res stills — not video — that feed Visual Intelligence. On-device processing filters blurred or obstructed shots before anything is used.

Leaked code shows camera AirPods capture synchronized 1-megapixel RGB stills with both active and passive capture modes. Safeguards include a status light, movement detection and on-device person detection.

The camera AirPods are framed as visual sensors for the new Siri AI rather than a recording device, with an LED indicator whenever visual data leaves the device. It's a design answer to the ambient-camera privacy problem smart glasses keep failing.

Apple shipped AirPods beta firmware 9A5347a adding the redesigned iOS 27 AirPods interface, an adaptive-mode slider and custom EQ. It's the first look at how Siri AI-era controls are being rethought on wearables.

iOS 27 beta 6 continues Apple's testing of the overhauled Siri AI, with enhanced conversation, personal context and on-screen intelligence. It's the last stretch before the assistant ships to every supported iPhone next month.

RayNeo split its AR line in two directions at once: the lightweight, camera-free iO for all-day AI assistance and the heavier GT series built for cinema-scale viewing. Two opposite bets on what smart glasses are actually for.

RayNeo's iO adds a HUD display with AI features but deliberately omits a camera, while the GT and GT Max push virtual screens up to 307 inches. The spec split shows how differently vendors are reading smart-glasses demand.

A new Meta patent proposes a physical 'hardware lock' for smart-glasses cameras, aimed at the severe backlash over always-on AI eyewear. It reframes privacy as an industrial-design problem rather than a settings screen.
Xreal says reservations for its Android XR glasses, Project Aura, have blown past 10,000 units ahead of an autumn launch. CEO Chi Xu calls the early demand for Gemini-powered eyewear 'exciting'.
A UK cinema trade body wants Meta's camera glasses barred from screenings, this time over piracy rather than privacy. Camera-bearing AI wearables are starting to hit real-world venue rules.

The Pixel Watch 5 can generate a custom watch face from a spoken prompt in 10–20 seconds, constrained to a set of sanctioned layouts. It's generative customization inside a design system, not a blank canvas.
Pixel Watch 5 runs Gemini on-device for basic tasks without a phone and adds AI-generated watch faces and better sleep models. Several promised AI features, though, don't land until September.

Gemini Intelligence features like Proactive Assistance are the real story of the Pixel 11 Pro, while the new HiLight hardware shipped incomplete. A case study in AI software carrying a hardware launch.

Gemini for Home's latest update finally handles specific kelvin color-temperature commands, better Spotify recognition and cleaner broadcasts. Small fixes that expose how much of AI smart-home UX is command-parsing craft.

A proposed class action claims Oura's smart rings overstate sleep-tracking accuracy because they lack brain and eye-movement sensors. The suit puts a legal price on how confidently AI health wearables present inferred data.

Unitree's 'Superman' humanoid hit 12.66 m/s and a two-meter standing jump, edging past Usain Bolt's peak sprint speed. The reveal landed just ahead of the World Robot Conference and Humanoid Robot Games.

Sandbar argues the next AI wearable interface is voice capture for stray thoughts, built into a ring rather than a screen. Its Stream ring is a bet that keeping the human in control is the core design constraint.
